content: Toledo Children's Hospital is a public pediatric hospital situated in Toledo, Ohio. It operates within The Toledo Hospital and is administratively integrated into the ProMedica Health System. The hospital is designated as a Level I trauma center and is equipped with 151 beds, 78 of which are dedicated to intensive care services. In 2006, Toledo Children's Hospital provided care to 4,856 patients. During the same year, the hospital managed 26,469 emergency cases and performed nearly 2,000 surgical procedures.
